# Rock Solid Leveling

> Rock Solid Leveling is an Omaha, Nebraska concrete leveling business that lifts, levels, and restores settled concrete using grout pumping. The business was formerly known as R&B Concrete Leveling and Repair.

Rock Solid Leveling serves homeowners and businesses in Omaha and nearby communities. Services focus on repairing existing concrete slabs when leveling is a practical alternative to tear-out and replacement. This type of work is often referred to as mudjacking or mud jacking, though some companies use mud and others use foam. Rock Solid uses cement-based grout.

## Services

- Concrete leveling
- Concrete lifting
- Driveway leveling
- Driveway caulking
- Sidewalk and walkway leveling
- Patio, stoop, and landing lifting
- Garage approach repair
- Garage floor leveling
- Expansion joints
- Trip hazard removal
- Void filling beneath settled concrete slabs

## Service Area

Primary service areas include Omaha, Elkhorn, Millard, Bennington, Boys Town, Ralston, La Vista, Papillion, Bellevue, Gretna, Waterloo, and Valley.

Nearby communities may include Council Bluffs, Carter Lake, Springfield, Blair, Plattsmouth, Ashland, and Fremont, depending on scheduling and project scope.

## Method

Rock Solid Leveling uses grout pumping. Small ports are drilled into the affected slab, a grout mix is injected beneath the concrete to fill voids and lift the slab, and the ports are patched after leveling.

The site positions grout-based leveling as a durable, cost-effective alternative to replacement for many settled concrete problems.
